units.rawText: Still, you mustn't tell lies like that. As far as Riko knows, there's nobody in the Oasis with that skillset.

units.rawText: Look at Nora and Helix's earnest eyes. Can you really bear to upset them?

units.rawText: She insisted on staying by herself in the shrine. Looks like it's time to call her back.
units.displayText: She insisted on staying by herself in the shrine. Looks like it's time to call her back.

spans.text: She insisted on staying by herself in the shrine. Looks like it's time to call her back.

units.rawText: Hopefully, she'll get used to life outside the shrine soon... Hehe, although, she should be able to blend in with the Oasis soon if she's with friends of like mind.

units.rawText: So that person you're talking about lives in the shrine?

units.rawText: Yup.
units.displayText: Yup.

spans.text: Yup.

units.rawText: She's a miko who serves the kami...
units.displayText: She's a miko who serves the kami...

spans.text: She's a miko who serves the kami...

units.rawText: ...That miko dancing up there looks graceful. She's accounted for all the ritual elements in her performance. Well done.

spans.text: ...That miko dancing up there looks graceful. She's accounted for all the ritual elements in her performance. Well done.

units.rawText: That's a Universal Anything Services S55-HMK priestess Doll. Who'd have thought that even the mikos who commune with the gods would end up like this...

spans.text: That's a Universal Anything Services S55-HMK priestess Doll. Who'd have thought that even the mikos who commune with the gods would end up like this...

units.rawText: Well, that's no good. The gods require sincere devotion. What do Dolls know of faith? They don't even have hearts.

spans.text: Well, that's no good. The gods require sincere devotion. What do Dolls know of faith? They don't even have hearts.

units.displayText: That's right! The very existence of a Doll like this is blasphemy against the kami!

spans.text: That's right! The very existence of a Doll like this is blasphemy against the kami!

units.rawText: Focus. Ignore that idle gossip. The kami themselves are watching your dance.

spans.text: Focus. Ignore that idle gossip. The kami themselves are watching your dance.

units.rawText: ...I shall abide by your teachings, Kaede-sama.
units.displayText: ...I shall abide by your teachings, Kaede-sama.

spans.text: ...I shall abide by your teachings, Kaede-sama.

units.rawText: At this rate... the kami will surely see...
units.displayText: At this rate... the kami will surely see...

spans.text: At this rate... the kami will surely see...

units.rawText: Will the kami... see this...
units.displayText: Will the kami... see this...

units.rawText: Then I must keep dancing...
units.displayText: Then I must keep dancing...

spans.text: Then I must keep dancing...

units.rawText: Found you at last...
units.displayText: Found you at last...

spans.text: Found you at last...

units.rawText: In the darkness, someone answers her thoughts, and as they reach a hand out to her, a blinding light shatters the long night...
units.displayText: In the darkness, someone answers her thoughts, and as they reach a hand out to her, a blinding light shatters the long night...

spans.text: In the darkness, someone answers her thoughts, and as they reach a hand out to her, a blinding light shatters the long night...

units.displayText: Your Holiness...

spans.text: Your Holiness...

units.rawText: Were you calling to me?
units.displayText: Were you calling to me?

spans.text: Were you calling to me?

units.rawText: As I watch the dazed Doll extending her hand to me, I smile and take her hand in response.
units.displayText: As I watch the dazed Doll extending her hand to me, I smile and take her hand in response.

spans.text: As I watch the dazed Doll extending her hand to me, I smile and take her hand in response.

units.displayText: Hehe, you don't need to be so formal around me. Just call me Professor.

spans.text: Hehe, you don't need to be so formal around me. Just call me Professor.

units.rawText: I see you're awake at last, Kimie. You'll catch a cold if you sleep under a tree during late autumn.
units.displayText: I see you're awake at last, Kimie. You'll catch a cold if you sleep under a tree during late autumn.

spans.text: I see you're awake at last, Kimie. You'll catch a cold if you sleep under a tree during late autumn.

units.displayText: Ah... to think this Kimie would actually fall asleep while preparing for Akimatsuri... How disgraceful...

spans.text: Ah... to think this Kimie would actually fall asleep while preparing for Akimatsuri... How disgraceful...

units.rawText: If you're tired, you should go back inside and rest.
units.displayText: If you're tired, you should go back inside and rest.

spans.text: If you're tired, you should go back inside and rest.

units.rawText: Akimatsuri is almost upon us, and there are still many things that must be done in the shrine. Whether it's cleaning, preparing offerings, and so on, I had only just begun my tasks; this Kimie cannot possibly be slothful.
units.displayText: Akimatsuri is almost upon us, and there are still many things that must be done in the shrine. Whether it's cleaning, preparing offerings, and so on, I had only just begun my tasks; this Kimie cannot possibly be slothful.

spans.text: May I know why you have visited this shrine, Professor?

units.displayText: Kimie dusts herself off and I hand her the broom which had fallen onto the ground.

spans.text: Kimie dusts herself off and I hand her the broom which had fallen onto the ground.

units.rawText: I was planning to send you a video call, but then I remembered that comm signals in this area are jammed.
units.displayText: I was planning to send you a video call, but then I remembered that comm signals in this area are jammed.

spans.text: I was planning to send you a video call, but then I remembered that comm signals in this area are jammed.

units.rawText: Sorry to disturb you unannounced, Kimie.
units.displayText: Sorry to disturb you unannounced, Kimie.

spans.text: Sorry to disturb you unannounced, Kimie.

units.rawText: There is no need to apologize. After all, it was you who asked the agents to help build this shrine in order to accommodate my reclusive ways.
units.displayText: There is no need to apologize. After all, it was you who asked the agents to help build this shrine in order to accommodate my reclusive ways.

spans.text: There is no need to apologize. After all, it was you who asked the agents to help build this shrine in order to accommodate my reclusive ways.

units.rawText: In truth, I was startled by how well I was treated upon arriving at the Oasis. I rejoice every day that I was found and that I did not have to wander outside.
units.displayText: In truth, I was startled by how well I was treated upon arriving at the Oasis. I rejoice every day that I was found and that I did not have to wander outside.

spans.text: In truth, I was startled by how well I was treated upon arriving at the Oasis. I rejoice every day that I was found and that I did not have to wander outside.

units.rawText: However, I do not know how I, in my seclusion, will be able to serve you, Professor.
units.displayText: However, I do not know how I, in my seclusion, will be able to serve you, Professor.

spans.text: However, I do not know how I, in my seclusion, will be able to serve you, Professor.

units.rawText: Hm. A string of supernatural events have occurred in the Oasis recently. We're a regular spook factory now.

spans.text: Hm. A string of supernatural events have occurred in the Oasis recently. We're a regular spook factory now.

units.rawText: I was hoping you could make your rounds and, if there truly is some kind of spiritual disturbance, that you could help dispel it. Even if it's just a misunderstanding, seeing you around will help soothe everyone's worries.
units.displayText: I was hoping you could make your rounds and, if there truly is some kind of spiritual disturbance, that you could help dispel it. Even if it's just a misunderstanding, seeing you around will help soothe everyone's worries.

spans.text: I was hoping you could make your rounds and, if there truly is some kind of spiritual disturbance, that you could help dispel it. Even if it's just a misunderstanding, seeing you around will help soothe everyone's worries.

units.displayText: This Kimie has not visited the various dignitaries of the Oasis even after my arrival. It seems this Kimie has been impolite.

spans.text: This Kimie has not visited the various dignitaries of the Oasis even after my arrival. It seems this Kimie has been impolite.

spans.text: This Kimie will contribute her humble efforts to the Oasis, be it to propitiate the kami or banish the unclean.

spans.text: But if I leave the shrine... I fear...

spans.text: (Coughs) I'm getting old and my body is failing me, yet there are fewer and fewer people around me now...

spans.text: It is time to begin appointing a successor. Kimie, do you like it here?

units.rawText: The shrine is your life, Kaede-sama. I know no greater honor than to be appointed to its keeping and to receive your care, Kaede-sama.
units.displayText: The shrine is your life, Kaede-sama. I know no greater honor than to be appointed to its keeping and to receive your care, Kaede-sama.

spans.text: The shrine is your life, Kaede-sama. I know no greater honor than to be appointed to its keeping and to receive your care, Kaede-sama.

spans.text: In that case... I now entrust Kurenoyume Shrine to you.

units.rawText: ...Kaede-sama, this... This Kimie understands. This Kimie shall abide by your teachings.

spans.text: ...Kaede-sama, this... This Kimie understands. This Kimie shall abide by your teachings.

units.displayText: Can you promise me one thing?

spans.text: Can you promise me one thing?
